payload.title: Comprehensive Guide to NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture
payload.summary: An overview of the NVIDIA Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra platforms, covering key architectural innovations, product configurations, and scaling law implications.

sections.heading: 1. NVIDIA Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra Overview
sections.gist: NVIDIA Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra are designed to address the escalating complexity of artificial intelligence — including growing model sizes and inference demands — incorporating multiple groundbreaking innovations.

sections.heading: 2. Eight Architectural Innovations
sections.gist: - **208 billion transistors** — over 2.5x that of the Hopper GPU - **TSMC 4NP process** (a 4nm high-performance variant, essentially part of the 5nm family) - Single-chip compute capability up to **20 petaFLOPS** - Two dies connected via *…

sections.heading: 3. GB300 NVL72 / GB200 NVL72
sections.gist: **GB300 NVL72**: 36 Grace CPUs + 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, liquid-cooled rack, 37 TB fast memory per rack, >1 PFlops FP4 compute.

sections.heading: 4. Real-Time Video Generation
sections.gist: Current state-of-the-art LLM context windows handle only 128K tokens, while 5 seconds of video requires 4 million tokens.

sections.heading: 5. HGX B300 / HGX B200
sections.gist: - **HGX B300**: 7x AI compute over Hopper, 2 TB+ HBM3e, integrated ConnectX-8 SuperNIC - **HGX B200**: x86 platform, 144 PFlops AI performance, 15x over HGX H100, 12x TCO reduction, up to 1000 W per GPU
